note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Guides are this entry's own words, built from the official descriptions; where a place or step is not pinned down by the official description, the guide says so instead of inventing it. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned - there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: follow the roadmap in order, story first, and let the checklist count you down. The last trophies most players earn are the long grinds - 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots and 100% completion - so start those early and chip away between missions.
steps: Use the Roadmap tab: story first, then activities, then collectibles, then money and mayhem.
Mop up the long grinds last - 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100% completion.
trophies.tips: Start the long grinds early and chip away between missions so they finish naturally.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and checklist item the game counts. This is the longest trophy after the platinum itself - use the in-game stats page to see what is left, and work the Roadmap's final stage last. Start the long grinds (stunts, WAiNK, vehicles, areas) early so they finish naturally.

Check the in-game stats page for what is still missing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. A stunt is a jump, a long drift, a near-miss or big air - the game counts them as you play, so this fills up naturally if you drive fast and take jumps. To farm it, repeat a good jump run in a fast car. PSN tracks the count to 250.
trophies.area: Leonida - roads, jumps and open ground
steps: Find jumps and ramps around Leonida.
Chain airtime, drifts and near-misses - the counter is cumulative.
trophies.tips: Stunts count cumulatively across the whole game, so every jump from the first hour counts. The exact best farming spot is not yet confirmed, so this guide names no single location as proven.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once - fishing, races, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and one more the game lists. You do not need to win or finish them well, just try each once. Check the Activities filter in this guide to see which trophies belong to which activity, and tick them off as you sample each one.
steps: Open the map and activity list.
Try one of each of the 9 activity types.
The trophy pops on the last type you try.
trophies.tips: You do not need to win or finish well - just try each type once.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and time, so learn the target layout on a slow first attempt, then run it clean and fast. You can retry any challenge as often as you like - nothing here is missable. PSN tracks the count to 42.
steps: Learn each challenge's weapon and target pattern.
Earn gold in each of the 42 challenges - retry any challenge as often as you like.
trophies.tips: Gold needs accuracy and speed, not just hits - run it slow once to learn the targets, then push for time.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.area: Leonida - Top Fun drone race spots
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Repeat at all 14 locations - the trophy pops on the 14th win.

Move to a different race - replays of a won race do not count.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner in the car or beside you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. If the moment passes, look for another chance to roam with your partner at high heat.
trophies.time: About 1 h when the chance comes
steps: Play with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars clear - together.
trophies.tips: If the moment passes, look for another chance to roam with your partner at high heat.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, and move straight to the next two while the heat stays on. If the wanted level drops, the chain breaks - start the run again.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop.
Keep the wanted level - move straight to a second shop and rob it.
trophies.tips: Pick three shops close together before you start; if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start again.

trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: the three robberies must chain without losing the wanted level, and they must happen with your partner. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed. Plan a route past three close shops before you start.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a showroom car straight out through the front - the glass, the doors, the whole display. The official description does not name which showroom, so this guide names none as proven - try it in the first showroom you can drive in.
steps: Smash your way out through the front - glass, doors, the whole display.
trophies.tips: The official description does not name which showroom, so this guide names none as proven - try it in the first showroom you can drive in.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: smashing out of a showroom is a one-time stunt per showroom, and it may only be possible in a specific story moment. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed. Do it the first time you are inside a showroom with a car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game of bowling, and finish it - the trophy is about playing the game through, not a score. Any completed game counts.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play it through to the end.
trophies.tips: The trophy is about playing the game through, not a score. Any completed game counts.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague - 'A partnership with mass appeal.' It points to a story moment with your partner, and this guide does not invent which scene it is: play the story with your partner and it should unlock at the partnership beat. Marked as a possible missable only because the moment reads as a single story event.
steps: Play the story with your partner.
Reach the partnership moment the description hints at.
trophies.tips: This guide does not invent which scene it is - play the story with your partner and it should unlock at the partnership beat.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: the description hints at a single story moment with your partner. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed. It should unlock through normal story play; if it does not pop, check this guide's notes after the story's partnership beats.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Story and free-roam choices add up - PSN tracks a count to 500 - so just play and choose as you go. There is no single right choice to make; the trophy is about the accumulation of decisions across the playthrough.
steps: Make story choices as they come.
Keep choosing in missions and free roam.
The count builds across the playthrough - PSN tracks it to 500.
trophies.tips: There is no single right choice to make; the trophy is about the accumulation of decisions.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: choices are one-time per playthrough, so a choice made cannot be unmade without replaying. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed. Do not worry about picking 'right' - make choices as they come and the count builds.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description is a hint, not an instruction: 'Second time's the charm.' It points to failing once and succeeding on the second try at a single story moment. This guide does not invent which moment - if a story beat fails and you retry it, the trophy may pop on the success.
steps: Attempt the story beat and fail once.
Succeed on the second try - the trophy may pop on the success.
trophies.tips: This guide does not invent which moment - if a story beat fails and you retry it, watch for the pop.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: it describes succeeding on a second attempt, which may only be possible at one specific story moment. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description is a reaction, not an instruction: 'What the hell just happened?' Something strange happens somewhere in Leonida - a UFO-style moment, a weird encounter - and this guide does not invent where. Explore odd places and the trophy pops when you witness it.
steps: Watch for something strange - a weird encounter or event.
The trophy pops when you witness it.
trophies.tips: This guide does not invent where it happens. Explore odd places and the trophy pops when you witness it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
trophies.missable_note: Flagged as a possible missable: it describes witnessing one strange event, which may happen once. Inferred from the official description - not yet confirmed. Keep an eye out while exploring, especially at night and in remote spots.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by - knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. Any road and any pedestrian count, so it is not missable.
steps: Strike them with the melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
trophies.tips: Any road and any pedestrian count, so it is not missable.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists - take them to a contact to launder them into clean cash, and the total builds up. Keep robbing and laundering through the whole game; the count is cumulative.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Take them to a contact to launder them into clean cash.
trophies.tips: Keep robbing and laundering through the whole game; the count is cumulative.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts - clothes, weapons, vehicles, upgrades - so just buy what you need as you play and the total builds. Do not waste money early; the big vehicle and weapon purchases late in the game will finish it.
steps: Buy clothes, weapons, cars and upgrades.
trophies.tips: Do not waste money early; the big vehicle and weapon purchases late in the game will finish it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages cost money, so this is money-gated: earn cash from missions, robberies and laundering, then buy garages as you can afford them. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is bought.
steps: Earn money from missions, robberies and laundering.
Repeat for all 8 garages - the trophy pops on the eighth.
trophies.tips: Garages cost money, so this is money-gated: buy them as you can afford them.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Each vehicle counts once - register the cars you drive and own until you reach ten. Check the app to see which vehicles are already registered.
steps: Register a vehicle you own or find.
trophies.tips: Check the app to see which vehicles are already registered.
trophies.sources: Sources: official trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN target); guide: our own advice from the official description - not yet checked in the game.
